topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Oh my gosh, can you believe it? This place is like a time capsule of all our memories, and now it's ours to keep them alive! I was walking through the rooms yesterday, and every step brought back a flood of moments—Grandma's cinnamon rolls in the kitchen, the creaky floorboards in the hallway where we used to play hide and seek, her garden with all those daisies we’d weave into crowns. It’s not just a house; it’s a treasure chest of her love. We’ve got to figure out how to make it our own while keeping her spirit everywhere. What do you think? Should we start in the kitchen, where all the best stories begin? I can’t wait to hear your ideas!
